replace.title: Transcribe the Tape again?
replace.description: The Tape's text will be replaced by the new transcription: your corrections and the speakers' names will be lost. The audio stays as it is in the Tape, without new cleaning. Cancelling or an error leaves the existing Tape unchanged.
replace.manualDescription: This Tape contains manual corrections. A new transcription will replace the text, speaker assignments and speaker names, including your manual corrections. The audio stays as it is in the Tape, without new cleaning. Cancelling or an error leaves the existing Tape unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How Memotape records, transcribes and saves your Tape.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Models transcribe on your computer: download them once, then they work offline.
transcription.diarizationDescription: Identifies Speakers after Transcribing files and Tapes, or after Stop in Recordings. Sortformer distinguishes up to 4 Speakers.
transcription.experimentalDescription: Experimental feature: speakers may be confused, especially with overlapping voices or many people.
transcription.recordingDiarizationDescription: Speakers are identified after Stop; only live Transcription continues during Recording.
transcription.localModelDescription: Select the compatible Nemotron 3 Diarization BF16 model. It is used for files, Tapes and recordings, including separate inputs.

vocabolario.title: Vocabulary
vocabolario.description: Names, brands and technical words that every Transcription should spell exactly like this. They apply from the next Transcription and don't change Tapes already transcribed.
vocabolario.label: New Term
vocabolario.placeholder: A name, a brand, a technical word
vocabolario.nonAmmesso: “{{termine}}” contains <| or |>, which the Whisper prompt does not allow.
vocabolario.scartati_one: {{count}} line skipped: duplicate or containing <| or |>.
vocabolario.scartati_other: {{count}} lines skipped: duplicates or containing <| or |>.
vocabolario.whisper: With Whisper the Terms also go into the initial prompt: with a long list Whisper only considers the last ones.

recording.title: Recording and audio
recording.parlantiDescription: With live Transcription enabled, identifies Speakers in the selected Inputs after Stop. Microphone and System audio are analysed separately.
recording.inactiveDescription: This Input will not be recorded. Cleaning and Speech sensitivity stay saved for when you record from it again.
recording.gainDescription: Changes the recorded level without changing Windows volume. Lower the Gain when the meter turns red. During Recording, changes apply to subsequent audio; when paused, from resume.
recording.bitrateDescription: Higher values retain more audio detail and use more storage.
recording.channelsDescription: Mono saves one channel; Stereo preserves the left and right channels.
recording.sampleRateDescription: Higher values retain higher frequencies. They cannot restore frequencies missing from the source.
recording.lastInput: At least one source is needed

general.title: General
general.description: The Library folder, the Copy text format, the theme and the interface language.
general.folderDescription: Where Memotape saves Tape: its folders are the Collections. Created if it doesn't exist; changing it doesn't move the Tape of the previous folder.
general.languageRestart: The new language takes effect the next time Memotape starts.
general.nomeMicrofonoDescription: Used for the Microphone when you don't recognize several speakers: every new Tape recorded from Both names it this way. Existing Tapes don't change.

assistants.title: Assistants
assistants.description: Claude and Codex can search and read your Tape through an MCP server, even when Memotape is closed.
assistants.allow: Allow assistants to read the Library
assistants.allowDescription: Assistants search and read the titles and text of your Tape without changing them. What they read goes to Anthropic's or OpenAI's servers: it leaves your PC.
assistants.connectDescription: Copy the configuration into the assistant and restart it.
assistants.claudeCode: Claude Code: run the command in a terminal

cleaning.description: DeepFilterNet3 reduces noise in imported audio and video files. The Tape keeps the processed audio: turning cleaning off cannot restore the original.
cleaning.recordingDescription: DeepFilterNet3 reduces recorded noise, even without live Transcription. Changes apply to subsequent audio; when paused, from resume. The Tape keeps the processed audio: turning it off cannot restore the original.

protection.label: Sensitivity
protection.scope: Filters speech for Transcription without changing the audio or cleaning. Also applies to imported files, not when transcribing a Tape. During live Transcription, changes apply to subsequent speech, keeping the current Phrase intact.

descriptions.spento: Disables the additional filter; normal speech detection remains active.
descriptions.sensibile: Keeps more quiet voices and short replies; may include more noise.
descriptions.bilanciato: Balances quiet voices and short replies with noise filtering.
descriptions.selettivo: Filters more noise; may lose short or quiet words.

save.restored: The previously saved value remains in effect.

mode.frase: Text at the end of each phrase

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The model file will be deleted from disk. To use it again you'll need to download it again.

speechLanguage.label: Speech language
speechLanguage.notHonored: {{model}} detects the language by itself: this choice only discards sentences written in another script.

recording.title: Recording
recording.cleaningFailed: Noise cleaning stopped for {{input}}. This recording continues keeping this input’s audio without further cleaning.
recording.cleaningBypass: Cleaning stopped: your choice remains saved, but this input continues without cleaning until Stop. Speech sensitivity keeps its selected value.
recording.cleaningScope: Changes affect only subsequent audio; while paused, they apply on resume. Turning cleaning off does not restore earlier audio.
